transcript: Forget ElevenLabs. Instead, use this free and open source alternative that lets you guys clone your voice with just 3 seconds of audio. The tool's called OmniVoice, and you just give it a few seconds of literally any voice, and it'll copy it perfectly with the exact tone, rhythm, and natural emotions. Then you can use it to generate speech, stories, and even full conversations in that exact same voice across almost 500 languages. Plus, you guys get fine controls to tune gender, age, accent, pitch, emotions, and more, plus a built-in MCP server that lets it connect directly with Claude Code or other coding agents. So if you guys want to try this for yourselves, just comment "Voice" down below and I'll send you the link directly.
